title: Let Cloudflare Web Analytics run and say so in the Privacy Policy
acceptance: The production CSP in public/_headers and netlify.toml admits exactly https://static.cloudflareinsights.com in script-src and nothing else changes (the injected beacon reports to the site's own /cdn-cgi/rum, covered by 'self'); src/core/csp.test.js pins the script origin and that connect-src admits no Cloudflare Insights host, in both policies.

PRIVACY.md no longer says RISE has no analytics; it states what Cloudflare Web Analytics collects and does not collect, citing Cloudflare's documentation, its retention, and the legal basis, and replaces the 'we would ask first' promise.
The published public/PRIVACY.md and public/privacy.html match the source (npm run verify:legal).
After deploy, the owner observes no CSP error for the beacon in the browser console on rise.syberlabs.io and sees page views arrive in the Cloudflare Web Analytics dashboard.

evidence.note: Live HTML fetched with a browser user-agent carries Cloudflare's auto-injected beacon.min.js (data-cf-beacon version 2024.11.0, spa mode); the served CSP script-src is 'self' blob:, which refuses it. rise.syberlabs.space carries no beacon.

Red first: 3 failed, 13 passed across csp, enterprise/headers and cloudflare-headers tests before the policy change; after it, 8 header/CSP-related files 113 passed. Home and CSP tests 58 passed; verify:legal clean; ci-hygiene 9 checks clean; vite build exit 0.

Owner decision 2026-10-26: keep Cloudflare Web Analytics and revise the promise (option A), not an opt-in switch. Sources: developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/about/, data-metrics/data-origin-and-collection/, data-metrics/dimensions/, faq/, and www.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/.
Draft PR: CSP origins, Privacy Policy revision, two corrected claims, this record. Remote CI and owner observation after deploy pending; not merged.

activity.summary: Created and claimed on branch live-analytics-allowed: CSP admits the beacon, Privacy Policy discloses it, two now-false 'no third-party script' claims corrected. Owner observation after deploy pending.
Opened draft PR 738; remote CI and owner observation after deploy pending.

summary: Admit the auto-injected Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon in the production CSP and replace the Privacy Policy's 'no analytics' promise with an honest, sourced description.
